purpose: Every character file the game will load. Generate only these. A file that is not installed is skipped and that person keeps the painted body, including crew colors. Do not add extra variants.
rules: 1990s West Coast, worn and dusty, realistic proportions. Humanoid rig, arms down or A-pose, under 15000 triangles, one material. No animation purchase: the game retargets its own clips. No logos, no readable brand text, no real city or department names, no gang signs, no tattoos, no flags, no sport team marks. Do not mention a real person's likeness. Do not describe race or skin tone as an ethnicity. Do not use green, purple, yellow, or teal as a crew color. Jersey numbers are plain white digits with no team name. Jersey number for the first Red Kings man is 12.

reuse.rule: A reused mesh is not a new build. Crews that must show 3 or 4 distinct builds still need that many paid meshes. Women are never a recolor of a male mesh. Clothes are part of the mesh, so a hoodie cannot be recolored into a jersey, jacket, suit, or police uniform.

safeWithoutPaidGeneration.how: Point the ped slot at the four Locals files of the same gender. Street clothes match. This does not add builds. Locals keep their 4 distinct builds, and ped women use the two Locals women.
Texture edit of cop-m-1 (gray hair, more wear) on the same rig and mesh. One police build, not two. Police are not a 3 or 4 build crew.

notSafe: Do not reuse player.glb as a crew build. It is the same orange hoodie man, so the crew would not gain a distinct build.
Do not turn reds-m-1 into reds-m-2 by changing only the jersey number. That is the same lean build. reds-m-2 stays a separate paid body (shorter, older). Number 12 is reserved for reds-m-1.
Do not reuse a male mesh for any -f- file.
Do not reuse across crew, reds, blues, golds, unc, or cop. The outfits are different geometry.

animation: Every file uses the game 18 clips through src/retarget.js, matched by bone name. Blue Hand uses the same joint names as the orange player and a different joint order, so an index copied from the orange rig would skin the wrong finger. Do not buy animation clips. The orange player rig is not a donor body for other outfits.
